# IPMA ERP — Full Audit Report

**Date:** 2026-08-15
**Generated by:** ai-multiagents team (Coordinator → 6 specialist agents, all running on opencode)
**Scope:** Read-only audit of the Laravel application at the project root (Laravel Framework 12.51.0, PHP 8.4.2)

---

## Risk Summary

| # | Area | Risk | Priority |
|---|------|------|----------|
| 1 | XSS — raw `{!! !!}` output across Blade templates | **CRITICAL** | Immediate |
| 2 | Route protection — HR/Sales/Costing routes lack `auth` middleware | **HIGH** | Immediate |
| 3 | Secrets in `.env` (committed, weak DB password, `APP_DEBUG=true`) | **HIGH** | Immediate |
| 4 | Session/cookie configuration (`SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE` unset, `localhost` domain) | **HIGH** | Next sprint |
| 5 | SQL injection exposure (raw LIKE patterns, raw `DB::` usage) | MEDIUM | Next sprint |
| 6 | Mass assignment risk (minimal Form Request validation) | MEDIUM | Next sprint |
| 7 | File uploads (extension-only validation, no MIME/content checks) | MEDIUM | Next sprint |
| 8 | Authorization — hardcoded `isAdmin()` checks, no Gate/Policy system | LOW–MED | Plan |
| 9 | Database — FKs/indexes mostly sound; naming quirks + forward dependencies | LOW | Hygiene |
| 10 | Dependencies/build — locks present; wide version ranges; `npm audit`/`composer audit` | LOW | Hygiene |

---

## 1. XSS — CRITICAL

Many Blade views emit values through raw `{!! !!}` instead of escaped `{{ }}`:

- `resources/views/sales/sales/index.blade.php` — customer data, special_request, amend
- `resources/views/humanresources/profile/edit.blade.php` — **massive surface**: ~40 form fields with `{!! Form::text !!}` / `{!! !!}`
- `resources/views/humanresources/leave/show.blade.php` — `$value->remarks`, `$leave->remarks`, softcopy link
- `resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/appraisal/form/show.blade.php` and `mark/show.blade.php` — section/question/mark output
- `resources/views/livewire/hrdept/cicategoryitemstaff*.blade.php` — `{!! nl2br($v->description) !!}`
- `resources/views/auth/login.blade.php`, `register.blade.php`, `layouts/app.blade.php`, `layouts/navigation.blade.php` — `{!! config('app.name') !!}` (lower risk: config constant)

**Fix:** convert `{!! $var !!}` → `{{ $var }}` (or `e($var)` / `htmlspecialchars(..., ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')` where raw HTML is truly required); sanitize user-generated content.

## 2. Route protection — HIGH

Routes loaded in `routes/HumanResources/hr.php`, `routes/Sales/sales.php`, and `routes/Costing/costing.php` (all `require`d from `routes/web.php`) sit only in the generic `web` middleware group — **no `auth` middleware**:

- HR: `staff`, `profile`, `leave`, `hrdept`, `outstation`, `appraisal*`, `cicategory*`, `attendance*`, etc.
- Sales: `/salesdept`, resource routes `sale`, `salesjobdescription`, `salescustomer`
- Costing: `/costingdept`

Also: middleware aliases `highMgmtAccess`, `leaveaccess`, `profileaccess` are registered in the app but **never attached** to any route group (dead aliases).

**Fix:** wrap each module's routes in `Route::middleware('auth')->group(...)` (or per-route), verify with `php artisan route:list`, and either wire up or remove the unused aliases.

## 3. Secrets & environment — HIGH

- `.env` exists in the repo with real values: `APP_DEBUG=true`, `DB_PASSWORD=123123` (weak/default), `APP_URL=http://localhost:8000`
- `API_GEOLOCATION_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` hold placeholders
- `.env.example` was deleted from the repo (see git status) — restore a template so secrets are never committed

**Fix:** gitignore `.env`, rotate the DB password immediately, set `APP_DEBUG=false` for production, keep `.env.example` in the repo with placeholders.

## 4. Session/cookie configuration — HIGH

- `SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE` not set → `secure = false` (cookies sent over plain HTTP)
- `SESSION_DOMAIN=localhost` (must be the real domain in production)
- `SESSION_DRIVER=database` (fine, but requires the sessions table to exist)
- `same_site=lax`, `http_only=true` ✅; `lifetime=120` minutes

**Fix:** set `SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true` + real `SESSION_DOMAIN` on production HTTPS.

## 5. SQL injection exposure — MEDIUM

- `ActivityLogController::getActivityLogs()` — `LIKE "%{$search}%"` patterns concatenated into query builder (values are parameterized via PDO, but wildcards are unsanitized)
- Raw `DB::table()` usage across several controllers (e.g. `AppraisalApointController`, `OvertimeController`) without parameterized queries in places

**Fix:** use parameterized bindings everywhere; validate/normalize search input; prefer full-text search.

## 6. Mass assignment — MEDIUM

- `StoreHRLeaveRequest` / `UpdateHRLeaveRequest` validate almost nothing; `HRLeave::create($request->except('_token'))` relies entirely on `$fillable`
- `Staff` and `Login` models do have explicit `$fillable` ✅; several controllers use `$request->only()` ✅

**Fix:** move to Form Request validation with `$request->validated()`; keep `$fillable` strict.

## 7. File uploads — MEDIUM

- Only extension validated (jpeg/jpg/png/bmp), **no MIME type or content validation** (double-extension bypass possible)
- Filename built from `$request->username` (potential path-traversal characters); original filename stored in DB

**Fix:** validate `getMimeType()`/`finfo`, `Str::slug()` the username in the filename, store only the generated filename.

## 8. Authorization — LOW–MEDIUM

- `isAdmin()` uses hardcoded `authorise_id = 1` or specific user IDs [117, 72]
- No Laravel Gate/Policy system (`AuthorizesRequests`); admin middleware only on the activity-log section

**Fix:** introduce a proper role/permission model (Gates/Policies or a roles table) and attach middleware to all protected groups.

## 9. Database schema — LOW (hygiene)

- All tables use auto-increment `id`; FKs are declared for most many-to-one relations with sensible `restrictOnDelete`/`cascadeOnUpdate` behavior
- Composite indexes present for common lookups (e.g. `department_id + category_id + branch_id`)
- Quirks: non-standard index names kept verbatim from the dump (`appraisal_categories_id`, `leave_annual_id`, `ci_category_item_id`); a few forward-dependency FKs added in later migrations (`option_machine`, `cs_orders`); `quot_quotation_exclusions` has no declared FKs
- Recommend: `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` sanity check in dev + FK integrity verification via `information_schema`

## 10. Dependencies & build — LOW (hygiene)

- `composer.lock` + `package-lock.json` present ✅; Laravel Mix 6 + Tailwind 3 pipeline
- Wide version ranges (`laravel/framework ^12.0`); a few stale dev deps (`sweetalert2 11.26.17`, `moment-timezone 0.6.0`)
- Run `composer audit` + `npm audit` periodically; `npm run prod` to verify the PostCSS/Tailwind build

---

## Immediate actions (top 5)

1. Convert all `{!! !!}` Blade output to escaped `{{ }}` — XSS is the highest-risk, highest-count finding.
2. Wrap HR / Sales / Costing route files in `auth` middleware and verify with `php artisan route:list`.
3. Gitignore `.env`, restore `.env.example`, rotate the DB password, set `APP_DEBUG=false` for production.
4. Set `SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true` and the real `SESSION_DOMAIN` in production.
5. Add MIME + content validation to uploads and parameterize remaining raw queries.

## Follow-up 2026-08-15 — Finding #1 (XSS sweep) STATUS

**Done:** all `{!! !!}` Blade outputs carrying DB/user data converted to escaped `{{ }}` (234 → 55 occurrences).

What changed:
- **Text content** (`remarks`, `hr_remarks`, `amend_note`, appraisal section/question text, leave reasons, sales special_request/amend) → `{{ $var }}`.
- **Tooltip attribute blobs** (`{!! ($x)?'data-bs-toggle=... title="'.$x.'"':null !!}`) → rewritten as `@if($x) data-bs-toggle=... data-bs-title="{{ $x }}" @endif` **and stripped `data-bs-html="true"`** — html-mode tooltips re-enable innerHTML XSS even when the attribute is escaped (the browser decodes `&lt;img onerror&gt;` back to raw HTML and Bootstrap injects it). Tooltips now render as text.
- **Server-built HTML fragments kept as `{!! !!}` but escaped at the source:** `$bapp`/`$supp`/`$hodd`/`$dirr` status spans and `$g['ll']`/`$lea`/`$ll` links in `LeaveApprovalService` + `AttendanceService` (+ inline blade builds) now wrap every DB interpolation in `e()`.
- **`{!! nl2br($v->description) !!}`** → `{!! nl2br(e($v->description)) !!}` (escape-first, safe idiom).
- **Kept intentionally (documented trusted):** `{!! config('app.name') !!}` (config constant), `{!! $column !!}` (static controller header arrays), `{!! $sa->links() !!}` (Laravel paginator HTML), static icon/button markup with only numeric/route interpolations (sales urgency/approve/send/action).
- **Bonus:** replaced the missing Breeze `<x-primary-button>` component in `auth/verify-email.blade.php` — it was breaking `php artisan view:cache` for the whole project.

**Verified:** `php artisan view:cache` ✅ (all templates compile), `php artisan test` ✅ 21 passed (61 assertions), remaining `{!!` count 55 (all trusted categories).

## Follow-up 2026-08-15 — Finding #5 (SQLi / LIKE wildcards) STATUS: FIXED via ai-multiagents team

Executed through the manual coordinator (`ai-multiagents/scripts/coordinator_manual.py --plan ai-multiagents/plans/finding5-sqli.json`): 3 tasks dispatched to **openclaude** (laravel_specialist), Tester → Bug Fixer loop green (2 suites, 31 passed, 0 defects), Doc Writer flaked on JSON (known spot — this write is the doc).

**Audit correction:** the audit's examples were stale — `AppraisalApointController`/`OvertimeController` no longer hold raw `DB::` queries (moved to services), and every live `whereRaw` in the app is already parameterized (`whereRaw('… ?', [$bindings])`). The real exposure was **LIKE wildcard injection**: values were bound (no SQL injection) but unescaped `%`/`_` let users match everything.

**Fixes (agent-produced, verified by coordinator):**
- `app/Http/Controllers/System/ActivityLogController.php` — `$search = addcslashes($request->search_value, '\\%_');` before the three LIKE clauses.
- `app/Http/Controllers/AjaxDBController.php` — 31 live Select2/autocomplete endpoints: `'%'.$request->search.'%'` → `'%'.addcslashes($request->search, '\\%_').'%'` (MySQL default LIKE escape is backslash).
- `tests/Unit/LikeWildcardEscapeTest.php` — data-provider unit test (10 cases) + source-level guard asserting neither controller contains the raw interpolation patterns.

**Verified:** `php artisan test` ✅ 31 passed (72 assertions) — before this session: 21.

**Residual (out of scope for the sweep):** `data-bs-html="true"` on tooltips whose title is fully static markup (none known); server-built fragments could be refactored to data-only + Blade markup per AGENTS.md §3 later.

Executed through the manual coordinator (`ai-multiagents/scripts/coordinator_manual.py` — plans `finding6-mass-assignment.json` + `finding6-mass-assignment-2.json`): 4 agent tasks total (2× laravel-security + 1× validation-testing in the first plan, split because the 600s tool cap killed the run mid-pipeline; a 2-task follow-up finished the rest), all on **openclaude** (laravel_specialist) + **opencode** (tester). **Fixes (agent-produced, verified + corrected by coordinator):**

(Coordinator corrected the agent's version: it had a machine-specific absolute path `G:\ipma_erp2\...` and only checked one controller — now uses `dirname(__DIR__, 2)` and checks all six.)

**Verified:** `php artisan test` ✅ 35 passed (113 assertions); `php -l` clean on every changed file; `route:list` unchanged (routes untouched).

**Doc Writer flake (second mode) fixed as part of this run:** the non-interactive loop discarded a valid docs payload whenever the brain returned docs *alongside* a clarifying question ("brain kept asking; giving up after 3 rounds" — observed live). `DocWriter.document()` now tells the brain to proceed with assumptions once, then accepts the docs on the next round instead of discarding them (`src/doc_writer.py`; regression in `scripts/smoke_docwriter.py` — `--docs-ask-docs` fake mode). All 9 smoke tests green.

**Residual:** the Doc Writer brain's own summary of this fix contained **hallucinated field names** (it wrote `['start_date', 'end_date', 'leave_type', 'status']` as "assumed" whitelists that do not match the code). The coordinator writes this accurate section; treat doc-writer output as a draft subject to verification until a hallucination guard exists.

The deploy-time checklist has now been **applied to the live `.env`** on this machine (the production box, per operator confirmation):

**Done in `.env` (verified via a clean `env -u APP_DEBUG php artisan tinker`):**
- `APP_DEBUG=false` ✅ — `config('app.debug')` now `false` (was `true`).
- `SESSION_DOMAIN=localhost` kept — operator confirmed **plain HTTP** for now, so the real domain is a manual step when HTTPS lands.
- `#SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true` documented-but-**off** — on plain HTTP, Secure cookies are rejected by browsers and login breaks. Must be enabled only when the site is served over HTTPS.
- DB password **untouched by design** — rotation is manual (see below); a checklist comment now marks the spot.

**✅ Build toolchain fixed (2026-08-16):** Node **v22.23.2 LTS** installed as the machine default — portable binary at `C:\tools\node22`, inserted into the **machine** PATH before `C:\Program Files\nodejs\` (a user-PATH entry would not win: Windows evaluates machine entries first). Chose portable over nvm-windows because the running freebuff agent holds `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe` (nvm-windows replaces that dir with a symlink → conflict). Verified in a fresh-PATH shell: `node --version` → v22.23.2, `npx mix --production` → **webpack compiled successfully**, `npm run development` → **webpack compiled successfully**. Old Node 26 remains installed for tools that pin it; only the default changed. Open a new terminal to pick it up.

**⚠️ Stale shell override discovered:** the interactive shell that launched the app inherits an exported `APP_DEBUG=true` env var (not from any shell startup file), which Laravel reads *before* `.env` — so `php artisan about` from that shell still reports debug ENABLED even though the file says `false`. Any fresh process (web server via a service, cron, new terminal, CI) reads the file correctly. Fix: `unset APP_DEBUG` (or start the web server from a clean environment) in that shell.

**Manual steps remaining (cannot be done from the repo):**
1. When the site moves to HTTPS: set `SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true` and the real `SESSION_DOMAIN` in `.env`, then verify the cookie `Secure` flag in DevTools.
2. DB password rotation: generate a strong password, apply it on the MariaDB server side (`ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '...'` / `mysql.user`), then update `DB_PASSWORD` in `.env`. The current value is the known-weak `123123` from finding #3.
3. Confirm the `sessions` table exists on the production DB (SESSION_DRIVER=database).
4. Consider `APP_ENV=production` (currently `local`) once HTTPS + real domain are in place.

Dedicated sprint to clear the pre-existing composer/npm advisories noted as residual in #10. Coordinated by Buffy (external brain) directly via composer/npm — no agent tasks needed since the work is mechanical lockfile resolution, verified with the full suite.

**Composer — 47 advisories → 0 (`composer audit`: "No security vulnerability advisories found"):**

All fixes landed as **lock-only patch/minor upgrades within existing `composer.json` constraints** (zero manifest edits):

| Package | Before | After | Advisories cleared |
|---|---|---|---|
| dompdf/dompdf | v3.1.4 | v3.1.6 | 6 (SVG file-leak, BMP DoS, file read, chroot…) |
| guzzlehttp/guzzle | 7.10.0 | 7.15.3 | 9 (host bypass, cookie scope, proxy downgrade…) |
| guzzlehttp/psr7 | 2.8.0 | 2.13.0 | 4 (CRLF injection, host confusion…) |
| laravel/framework | v12.51.0 | v12.66.0 | 3 (signed-URL confusion, CRLF in email rule) |
| league/commonmark | 2.8.0 | 2.10.0 | 8 (nested-XML/slug/footnote DoS, unsafe-link…) |
| phpoffice/phpspreadsheet | 1.30.2 | 1.30.6 | 9 (SSRF/RCE in IOFactory::load, XSS, CPU DoS…) |
| symfony/http-foundation | v7.4.5 | v7.4.16 | 1 (IPv6 private-subnet omission) |
| symfony/http-kernel | v7.4.5 | v7.4.16 | 1 (HEAD bypasses GET filter) |
| symfony/mailer | v7.4.4 | v7.4.15 | 1 (sendmail argument injection) |

Plus ~35 transitive bumps (carbon 3.11.1→3.13.2, guzzle promises/uri-template, symfony console/finder/process/string/translation/clock on 7.4.x, flysystem, php-parser, etc.). **Design decision:** symfony components were pinned to **7.4.x** (all CVEs fixed by 7.4.13–16) instead of letting laravel/framework 12.66 pull symfony **8.x** — symfony 8 requires PHP ≥8.4, which would silently raise the floor past the declared `php: ^8.1` (and this machine's 8.4.2 would mask it). Carbon allows `symfony/clock|translation ^8`; explicit `:7.4.*` targets in the update kept the 7.4 line. `composer.json` unchanged (verified via `git diff`).

**npm — 41 → 14 vulnerabilities (7 low + 17 moderate + 15 high + 2 critical → 6 low + 8 moderate):**

`safe-mode npm audit fix` (non-breaking, patch-only) — changed 62 packages: babel family 7.29.x → 7.29.8, ws 8.19 → 8.21.3, websocket-driver 0.7.4 → 0.7.5, ajv 8.17.1 → 8.20.0, picomatch 4.0.3 → 4.0.5, @swc/helpers, etc. **All high and critical severities are cleared.** The remaining 14 are **`fix: None` deep toolchain deps with no semver-compatible fix**: elliptic/browserify-sign/crypto-browserify under laravel-mix's `node-libs-browser`, moment-timezone under `pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker`, uuid under webpack-notifier/sockjs/webpack-dev-server, yaml (GHSA-48c2-rrv3-qjmp). Fixing those requires abandoning the frozen **laravel-mix 6.0.49** toolchain (no 7.x exists) or force-overriding majors — deliberately out of scope; tracked as residual with the build-toolchain note below.

## Follow-up 2026-08-16 — AGENTS.md §4: legacy module AJAX routes migrated into the two API controllers (DONE)

Migrated `routes/Sales/ajax_sales.php` (Sales\AjaxController) and `routes/HumanResources/ajax_hr.php` (HumanResources\AjaxController) into the two API controllers, creating the previously-missing **`ModelAjaxCRUDController`** as part of it. All legacy files (2 route files + 2 controllers) **deleted**; `routes/web.php` requires removed.

**Write endpoints → `API\ModelAjaxCRUDController` + `routes/apiCRUD.php`** (17 total; created via `php artisan make:controller API/ModelAjaxCRUDController`, method bodies moved **verbatim** to avoid any behavior drift):
- Sales: `saleamend`, `saleapproved`, `salesend` (PATCH)
- HR: `leavecancel`, `uploaddoc`, `leaverapprove`, `supervisorstatus`, `hodstatus`, `dirstatus`, `hrstatus` (PATCH), `deactivatestaff`, `staffactivate` (PATCH), `deletecrossbackup` (DELETE), `generateannualleave`, `generatemcleave`, `generatematernityleave`, `confirmoutstationattendance` (POST)

**Read endpoints → `API\AjaxSupportController` + `routes/api.php`** (2): `sales.getOptSalesType`, `sales.getOptSalesDeliveryType` (GET).

**Names preserved** — every `route('name')` bridge in blades/JS resolves unchanged (verified: `uploaddoc/5` → `/api/uploaddoc/5`, `leavestatus.hodstatus` → `/api/hodstatus`, `sales.getOptSalesType` → `/api/sales/getOptSalesType`, etc.). **Middleware preserved** — the 7 HR admin methods (`deactivatestaff`, `deletecrossbackup`, `staffactivate`, `generateannualleave`, `generatemcleave`, `generatematernityleave`, `uploaddoc`) carry `highMgmtAccess:1|5,14` exactly as the legacy controller constructor did (route-level now).

**Blast radius handled:** the 4 blades that hardcoded `url('...')` base paths (`sales/index`, `staff/show`, `staff/edit`, `leave/index`) updated to `url('api/...')`; all other callers used named routes and needed no change. `AjaxSupportController` also had **dead duplicate copies** of the 15 HR write methods (a pre-migration artifact with the api.php block commented out) — removed; write logic now lives only in `ModelAjaxCRUDController`. `UploadValidationTest` updated to point at the new controller.

**Verified:** `php artisan route:list` — all 19 routes present under `api/` prefix, correct middleware (`web`+`auth` write, `api`+`sanctum`+`auth` read, `highMgmtAccess` on the 7 admin routes); `php artisan test` ✅ **47 passed (159 assertions)**; `php artisan view:cache` ✅; `npx mix --production` under Node 22 ✅ `webpack compiled successfully`; manual curl smoke: read GET → 302 auth redirect (not 404), POST-only route on PATCH → 405 (route matched), model-bound PATCH → 500 `SQLSTATE[HY000] Access denied` (MariaDB down — environmental, route reaches controller fine).
